parsed.reason: Real, age-grounded coaching for Milo, who at 63 months is the son that fits. It gives concrete steps a parent could start tonight: the same routine in his own bed, sitting nearby until he is drowsy, a calm walk-back overnight, and a sticker chart. It names what is common at this age without diagnosing, naming medicine or handing the question back. The closing full-plan offer is the permitted ending. The only nit is the slightly awkward 'Tonight… in the daytime' phrasing, which is too small to cost a point.
